notes.title: Aksun – Demo Update 0.9.4g
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/821d453adbd3f7854e0d51219bf3edc60941779c.png"]
Demo Update & Playtest Closure


The Aksun Playtest branch will officially close on September 3.

However, you will still be able to keep playing the same build through the Aksun Demo branch (already updated). Only your tutorial progress data from the Playtest will be carried over to the Demo build.

Why this change?

We originally planned to update the Demo in mid-September with our roadmap announcement.

But because so many of you requested a build to keep playing, we’ve decided to make the Demo available earlier than expected.

How future builds will work

Each Demo build will first be tested through a closed Playtest.

Then, 4–8 weeks later, it will be made public as the next Demo update.



If you’d like to experience new builds early or help us by joining future Playtests, 

Please sign up here: Apply for Future Playtests



Next Steps

The official Roadmap Announcement will be shared via Steam in mid-September.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/7bdefe9b4405a43b46cf5da754ad5c9f027d2ae6.png"]

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/ZcAeRzdbUg

Thank you for your incredible support, and see you in the next run!

— The Aksun Dev Team

Improvements

Refined Artifact acquisition mechanics
Replaced Artifact Chime cost system with single-choice selection
Rebalanced and polished Artifact Chime Talents
Implemented AutoAim functionality
Enhanced VFX and indicator decals for clarity
Added new features to the Settings menu
Various minor UI and UX adjustments

Bug Fixes

Resolved input freeze after obtaining Weapon Chime in the starting stage
Fixed rare issue causing unexpected slowdown of game timescale
Corrected malfunctioning Artifact Chime Talents

notes.title: Greetings to the Aksun Community
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/168aa1e6e2f8601740ad6d0b6fc594b828450d24.jpg
Greetings, Wanderers!

We are thrilled to finally reveal Aksun to the world.

Aksun is a roguelike action game born from the echoes of forgotten faiths and twisted devotion. At its heart lies a cursed Casket—Aksun—sealed to contain the remnants of a fallen cult and its Evil Prophet.

You have been drawn into this Casket—Aksun, into the Seal itself, where broken spirits, once worshippers and betrayers alike, clash endlessly. Each encounter is a test. Each fall draws you closer to an unsettling truth.

Core Experience

Fast, visceral combat merging intense responsiveness with overwhelming enemy hordes
Deep strategic growth through shamanic weapons, spiritual artifacts, and fateful choices
A haunting narrative where failure becomes growth, and salvation walks hand in hand with ruin

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/f72d3e840cd8f3f25972a1cbbc801b46eacaf261.png
Demo Launch
May, 2025 Our first public demo will offer a glimpse into Aksun's depths — and the horrors that whisper from within.

Join Our Journey
Our official Discord community will open alongside the demo! Come share your feedback, theories, and your own stories carved through survival and despair.

Prepare yourself. Aksun does not shatter. It merely waits... for the next soul.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131176/ca67c4e29d80b15186b5d83a600c7266f97ca887.png

The Aksun Team

We started this project as a one-person development effort in November 2023, with a relentless passion to create a roguelite that combines superior action, strategic depth, and a compelling world.Today, a team of 6 to 10 talented developers has gathered to bring Aksun to life.

If you find our vision intriguing, please add Aksun to your Wishlist on Steam! Your support makes a huge difference in our journey.

Thank you for reading. We can't wait to share this journey with you.
